summary.text: Jen Wiles is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 75, running against incumbent Republican Donny C. Lambeth in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wiles advanced from the Democratic primary for District 75 without appearing on the ballot.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Wiles listed three key campaign messages: raising wages to a living wage, funding public schools in every ZIP code, and protecting health care access, including Medicaid expansion.
